path_identity_note: Exact mapped correspondence to the original AIG node sequence is unavailable. ABC's explicit print_delay <PO> <PI> reports the maximum mapped timing path between the same PI/PO endpoints; the PO-wide maximum is also recorded separately.

pilot_selection.selection_rule: one minimum-delta candidate per executable root/cut, over saved Gate3B paths with an explicit ABC print_delay PO,PI endpoint-pair report, ranked by decision count desc, region count desc, PO asc

saved_path_policy: use saved Gate3B paths only; no path enumeration
